inv.desc_en:
INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY IN SEVILLE – COMMERCIAL PREMISES IN PLAZA EL JUNCAL
Magnificent 32 m² street-level commercial premises for sale, located in one of the liveliest areas of the El Juncal neighborhood (Seville 41005).
Excellent location: Plaza El Juncal, a well-established area with high foot traffic from residents, shops, bars, and surrounding services.
The property is currently rented, ideal for investors looking for a property with profitability from day one.
Main features:
• Approx. 40 m² built
• Direct street frontage
• Good commercial visibility
• Pedestrian thoroughfare
• Fully established neighborhood
• Currently generating rental income
• Ideal as a real estate investment
Perfect for various activities: office, retail, services, beauty salon, specialty shop, professional practice, etc.
An opportunity to acquire a real estate asset in Seville with a tenant and start earning returns without delay.
Plaza El Juncal – Seville (41005)
More information and viewings via private message.
